thread:
jessica: Customer is seeing intermittent 5xx and KMS signing errors during a nightly bulk-sign job. They report ~30% of requests failed with HSM session errors, and audit logs for keys x-foo/x-bar are missing between 2026-03-14T01:02:00Z and 01:08:00Z. Can someone triage? :eyes:
omar: Which environment? prod or dedicated? any recent deploys or key rotations?
jessica: prod (us-east-1). No deploys during window. They did run a high-concurrency batch that spikes sign rate from ~50/s to ~900/s for ~4m. Customer saw rapid retries and increased costs.
cloudhsm-bot: ALERT: CloudHSM cluster c-abc123 session usage 98% at 2026-03-14T01:05:18Z. Metric: activeSessions=248 (limit=250). Link: https://console.aws/..../c-abc123
lee: logs? paste the API error body and any HSM error lines from the connector.
jessica: pasted snippet: ```json
{"error":"KMS_SIGN_FAILED","details":"CKR_SESSION_COUNT or HSM_SESSION_LIMIT_EXCEEDED","request_id":"req_0a1b2c"}
```
Also captured connector log: ```
2026-03-14T01:04:59Z ERROR kms-proxy: sign failed: CKR_SESSION_COUNT (0x0A)
2026-03-14T01:05:00Z WARN  kms-proxy: retrying sign (attempt 3)
```
maria: this looks like session exhaustion. Did IAM creds rotate? Session leaks?
omar: checked rotation — no automatic rotation in that minute. Could be lack of session pooling or too many short-lived sessions opened by the client. Any client-side changes?
jessica: customer ran a new batch worker release that spawns one short-lived process per job (no connection reuse). Repro steps below.
jessica: repro steps to simulate (staging): ```bash
# open N parallel sign processes
for i in {1..400}; do 
  curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.example/v1/sign" \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{"key_id":"arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123:key/x-foo","payload":"abc"}' &
done; wait
```
Expected: some signs should succeed. Observed: many return 5xx with KMS_SIGN_FAILED or 403 HSM_UNAVAILABLE.
lee: good repro. We should capture connector logs + CloudHSM metrics. Can someone run this in staging with metric collection?
sec-sre: Also concerned about missing audit logs window. If HSM stopped accepting sessions, audit forwarder might have dropped events. We need to preserve whatever logs exist now before rotation/truncation. Get CloudTrail + HSM audit snapshot.
omar: opening a support case with HSM vendor now. Case includes cluster id, time window, sample request ids, connector logs, and stack traces.
cloudhsm-bot: Support case created: #AWS-CASE-98765 (link).
lee: Mitigations: 1) immediate throttle control on client side (limit concurrent signers). 2) implement exponential backoff + jitter for retries. 3) enable session pooling in kms-proxy (reuse sessions). 4) temporary fallback to software-based signing for non-PII keys if customer agrees.
maria: also suggest short-term increase of HSM session limit with vendor if possible, but that's not a long term fix. Add circuit breaker that fails fast if HSM session usage >90%.
jessica: customer asked about compliance: will missed audit events break retention requirements? They need confirmation for ATO-type reports.
sec-sre: we need to run forensics: retrieve HSM audit logs, our connector logs, and export them to S3 (write-once), then provide signed timeline to customer. Also include whether keys were accessible and whether any ops actions overlapped.
omar: noted potential billing impact: retries multiplied requests causing >3x token/egress usage during spike. Customer is asking for credit. We'll include cost estimate in the support case.
lee: quick command for capturing current HSM session metric and recent audit tail: ```bash
aws cloudwatch get-metric-statistics --namespace AWS/CloudHSM --metric-name ActiveSessions --start-time 2026-03-14T01:00:00Z --end-time 2026-03-14T01:10:00Z --period 60 --statistics Maximum
# and for audit tail (if using vendor cli)
vendor-cli hsm tail-logs --cluster c-abc123 --since 6m > /tmp/hsm-audit-tail.log
```
maria: after we confirm, action items: (1) run staged repro and attach metrics (omar+lee), (2) vendor escal8 (omar), (3) prepare audit log export and preservation (sec-sre+lee), (4) propose code fix for pooling & backoff (jessica+dev team).
jessica: assigning incident ticket RED-INC-2026-0314 and sharing with customer. I'll update once we have vendor response. :thumbsup: 
sec-sre: one extra note — add test in chaos/stress suite to spike signing concurrency in CI to detect regressions.
omar: copying final note from vendor after case opened: "We observed short bursts causing session limit breach. Recommended enabling persistent sessions and increasing session_limit to 500 while you refactor client. We can schedule a maintenance window to adjust."
jessica: thanks everyone. Will follow up with timeline for audit export and customer credit estimate.
